context: A uni student gives his teen friend life advice over coffee
purpose: Teach: まじめ/貧乏/ときどき/ついつい/おまけ/パンツ/ふえ/やってくる

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先輩、最近バイト先に変な客がときどきやってくるんですよ。
lines.en: Senpai, lately weird customers sometimes show up at my part-time job.
lines.style: Sakura sounds slightly annoyed but casual, venting to her older friend.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: へえ、大変だな。でもさ、社会に出たらもっと変な人がふえるぞ。
lines.en: Oh, that's rough. But you know, once you enter society, even weirder people will increase.
lines.style: Ren speaks with a relaxed mentor-like tone, casual upperclassman vibe.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: えー、まじですか。先輩はまじめに就活してるんですか?
lines.en: Ehh, seriously? Are you actually job-hunting seriously, senpai?
lines.style: Sakura teases playfully, leaning forward with curious teen energy.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一応な。お金ないし、学生は貧乏なんだよ。ついつい無駄遣いしちゃうけど。
lines.en: Sort of. I have no money, students are broke. I tend to splurge without thinking though.
lines.style: Ren laughs at himself, self-deprecating and warm in delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あはは、先輩なのに頼りない!でもコーヒーおごってくれたから許します。
lines.en: Haha, you're so unreliable for a senpai! But since you bought me coffee, I'll forgive you.
lines.style: Sakura giggles brightly with cheerful and teasing friendly manner.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: おまけにケーキも頼んでいいぞ。今日は俺の奢りだ。
lines.en: As a bonus, you can order cake too. Today it's my treat.
lines.style: Ren speaks generously with a confident big-brother kind of tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: やった!あ、先輩、ジャージのパンツに何かシミついてますよ、コーヒーこぼしました?
lines.en: Yay! Oh, senpai, there's some kind of stain on your sweatpants — did you spill coffee?
lines.style: Sakura points it out with playful concern, half-teasing in a friendly way.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うわ、マジか!さっきこぼしたやつだな…就活前に気づいてよかったよ。
lines.en: Whoa, seriously?! Must be from earlier... good thing I noticed before job-hunting.
lines.style: Ren reacts with flustered relief, scrubbing at the stain with a laugh.
